selector.why: The presence of a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene and the combination of basal cell carcinoma-like lesions with a family history of similar lesions and a personal history of meningioma decided it.

support_spans: multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored asymptomatic papules located on the face and vulva
buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces
A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples
Medical history was significant for a meningioma
contradict_spans: No palmar or plantar pits were observed
